name: llm-judge-bench-tr-en
description:
LLM Judge Benchmark: Turkish-English Subjective Text Evaluation
	


	
		
		Dataset Description
	

This dataset contains 25,274 LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations from a systematic benchmark comparing 16 large language models on subjective text evaluation tasks across 7 datasets (3 Turkish, 4 English).
Each record includes the full prompt sent to the LLM, the raw LLM response, the parsed score, and the human-annotated ground truth — enabling detailed analysis of both scoring accuracy and… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Guvenc/llm-judge-bench-tr-en.
reputation: A useful resource for studying LLM-as-judge performance across Turkish and English with growing attention from evaluation researchers.
